data.name: Button

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Set the button to autofocus on mount.

props.name: children
props.type: string | number | boolean | ReactElement<any, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | null | undefined
props.description: Text content to be rendered in the button.

props.name: iconAfter
props.description: Places an icon within the button, after the button's text.

props.name: iconBefore
props.description: Places an icon within the button, before the button's text.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disable the button to prevent user interaction.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Conditionally show a spinner over the top of a button

props.name: isSelected
props.description: Indicates that the button is selected.

props.name: onClick
props.type: ((e: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement, globalThis.MouseEvent>, analyticsEvent: UIAnalyticsEvent) => void) | undefined
props.description: Handler called on click. You can use the second argument to fire Atlaskit analytics events on custom channels. They could then be routed to GASv3 analytics. See the pressable or anchor primitive code examples for information on [firing Atlaskit analytics events](https://atlassian.design/components/primitives/pressable/examples#atlaskit-analytics) or [routing these to GASv3 analytics](https://atlassian.design/components/primitives/pressable/examples#gasv3-analytics).

props.name: shouldFitContainer
props.description: Option to fit button width to its parent width.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Controls the amount of padding in the button.
